description: Benchmark NOL4 against the other 101 human proteins that share its exact annotation provenance (GO:0003723, TAS, assigned by PINC): does each carry a UniProt RNA-binding keyword and a canonical RNA-binding domain?
code:
import requests, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S = requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'Accept':'application/json'})
Q = "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search"

# --- collect the full PINC / TAS / GO:0003723 human cohort (102 annotations) ---
accs, meta = [], {}
for page in (1,2):
    r = S.get(Q, params=dict(goId='GO:0003723', taxonId='9606', geneProductType='protein',
                             goUsage='exact', evidenceCode='ECO:0000304', assignedBy='PINC',
                             limit=100, page=page), timeout=40).json()
    for a in r['results']:
        acc = a['geneProductId'].split(':')[1]
        if acc not in meta:
            accs.append(acc); meta[acc] = (a.get('symbol','?'), a.get('reference','?'))
print(f"Cohort size (unique proteins): {len(accs)}")

# --- UniProt: keywords for the whole cohort in one batched request ---
U = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
kw = {}
for i in range(0, len(accs), 40):
    chunk = accs[i:i+40]
    q = " OR ".join(f"accession:{a}" for a in chunk)
    r = S.get(U, params={'query': q, 'fields': 'accession,gene_primary,keyword', 'size': 500,
                         'format': 'json'}, timeout=60).json()
    for e in r.get('results', []):
        kw[e['primaryAccession']] = set(k['name'] for k in e.get('keywords', []))

have_rna = [a for a in accs if 'RNA-binding' in kw.get(a, set())]
no_rna   = [a for a in accs if a in kw and 'RNA-binding' not in kw[a]]
print(f"UniProt keyword 'RNA-binding' present: {len(have_rna)}/{len(kw)} "
      f"({100*len(have_rna)/len(kw):.1f}%)")
print(f"absent: {len(no_rna)}")
print("\nCohort members WITHOUT the UniProt RNA-binding keyword:")
for a in sorted(no_rna, key=lambda x: meta[x][0]):
    other = [k for k in kw[a] if k in ('Ribosomal protein','Ribonucleoprotein','Nuclease',
                                       'Helicase','Methyltransferase','Hydrolase','Transferase',
                                       'Translation regulation','mRNA processing','mRNA splicing',
                                       'rRNA processing','Chaperone','Nucleus')]
    print(f"   {a:8s} {meta[a][0]:12s} ref={meta[a][1]:16s} other kw: {', '.join(sorted(other)) or '-'}")
print(f"\nNOL4 (O94818) keyword set: {sorted(kw.get('O94818', []))}")

# --- figure ---
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5.0))
ax = axes[0]
ev_counts = {'IEA\n(electronic)':2397,'IDA\n(direct assay)':1846,'IBA\n(phylogenetic)':226,
             'TAS\n(author stmt)':117,'IPI':34,'ISS':16}
cols = ['#9fb6cf']*len(ev_counts); cols[3] = '#c0392b'
ax.bar(range(len(ev_counts)), list(ev_counts.values()), color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(ev_counts))); ax.set_xticklabels(ev_counts.keys(), fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('human annotations to GO:0003723')
ax.set_title('Evidence codes for GO:0003723 in human (7,547 total)\nNOL4 sits in the 1.6% TAS slice (red)', fontsize=9.5)
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(ev_counts.items()):
    ax.text(i, v+60, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=8)

ax = axes[1]
n_with, n_without = len(have_rna), len(no_rna)
ax.barh([1,0], [n_with, n_without], color=['#2e7d5b','#c0392b'])
ax.set_yticks([0,1]); ax.set_yticklabels(['no RNA-binding\nkeyword','UniProt\nRNA-binding keyword'], fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('proteins in the PINC / TAS / GO:0003723 cohort (n = %d)' % len(kw))
ax.set_title('NOL4 against its own annotation cohort', fontsize=9.5)
ax.text(n_with-2, 1, str(n_with), va='center', ha='right', color='white', fontsize=10)
ax.text(n_without+0.5, 0, f'{n_without}, incl. NOL4', va='center', fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
